scripts.dev: bun run dev:infra && bun --cwd catalyst-backend run dev --host & bun --cwd catalyst-frontend run dev --host
scripts.dev:infra: cd catalyst-docker && podman-compose up -d --no-recreate postgres redis 2>/dev/null || podman-compose start postgres redis 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:all: bun run dev:infra && bun --cwd catalyst-backend run dev & bun --cwd catalyst-frontend run dev
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.start: bun run build && bun --cwd catalyst-backend run start
scripts.build:shared: echo 'catalyst-shared is types-only, nothing to build'
scripts.lint: bun --cwd catalyst-backend run lint && bun --cwd catalyst-frontend run lint
scripts.clean: rm -rf catalyst-backend/dist catalyst-backend/node_modules catalyst-frontend/dist catalyst-frontend/node_modules catalyst-shared/node_modules node_modules
